title: OGDC September 2026 Results: Revenue, Profit and EPS Explained
excerpt: Read OGDCL's September-quarter figures with the right units, distinguish profit from cash and understand the dividend percentage without confusing it with a return.
seoTitle: OGDC September 2026 Results: Revenue, Profit and EPS Guide
description: Understand OGDC's September 2026 quarterly results, revenue and profit units, EPS and dividend percentages with sourced figures and clear worked examples.
socialTitle: OGDC Results: Read the Units Before the Headline
socialDescription: A student-friendly guide to quarterly revenue, profit, EPS and dividend percentages, with original calculations.
limitations: Checked 1 November 2026. Educational financial-statement analysis, not investment advice or a price target.
Figures refer to the unaudited quarter ended 30 September 2026. Rupees in thousands distinguished from EPS rupees.
Growth calculations are original arithmetic from the issuer filing, not forecasts or inferred production changes.
Dividend percentage uses face value, not a market-price return. No trading-entitlement advice supplied.
Foreign equipment photographs illustrate industrial context and are explicitly not claimed as OGDCL installations.
Fictional price-volume and coding exercises are labelled separately from reported results.
